Weights here are the FULL intended set, including parameters not yet measurable
for every profile (VOICE_Q/NAV_EFF: blind/low_vision only; VIS_ENG: Phase 4,
P4-01; WRIT_EXP: diagnosticOnly under dysgraphia pending Phase 4's KNOW/EXPR
split). The engine renormalizes over whatever it can actually compute for a
given session, so declaring intent here costs nothing and the parameter
switches itself on when its data source lands.
Every profile's declared weights sum to 1.0 exactly (P3-10 weight-hygiene pass —
adhd and dyslexia previously summed to 1.10; deaf to 0.85 after WRIT_EXP's
removal). The engine ALSO renormalizes over the usable subset at scoring time,
so a profile naming a parameter the engine cannot yet measure is never
penalised for it — these are two different renormalizations for two different
IMPORTANT: these are literature-informed, NOT empirically validated. Any claim
made from them must say so. Run scripts/run_ablation.py after changing them.

_parameters.ADJ_ACC: Accuracy after confidence-weighted discount of attention-lapse errors
_parameters.TIME_EFF: Response time against the student's OWN baseline, not a cohort mean
_parameters.ATT_SPAN: Mean face-presence ratio. NOT gaze-on-content. Null without webcam consent
_parameters.PACE_STAB: 1 - coefficient of variation of response time across correct answers. Split out of the old combined CONSIST: response-time variability is itself a symptom of some disabilities (diagnosticOnly under adhd/autism), not a measure of reliability for everyone
_parameters.ACC_STAB: 1 - normalized variance of correctness across recent sessions. The other half of the old combined CONSIST; never diagnosticOnly, since being reliably accurate session-to-session is not itself a symptom of any profile's disability
_parameters.EFFORT: Engagement: answer changes, revisits, re-reads, time invested
_parameters.LRN_VEL: Slope of correctness over the session sequence
_parameters.TASK_COMP: Fraction of started sessions that were completed
_parameters.NAV_EFF: PHASE 3 — navigation efficiency for screen-reader/voice users
_parameters.PATTERN: Accuracy on sequence/category/matching items (quiz_gen itemKind), ≥3 such items
_parameters.RESIL: 1 − HES (interaction-only hesitation index: latency vs personal baseline, answer changes, tab-blur count, mean chatbot frustration_score — services/hesitation.py, P4-14). Renamed from FRUST so higher-is-better matches its positive weight
_parameters.VIS_ENG: PHASE 4 (P4-01) — engagement with visual content (diagram dwell, card expansions, replays). Defined; data source not yet built
_parameters.KNOW: PHASE 4 (P4-10) — concept coverage on short-answer items (services/writing_score.py), evidenced by a verbatim quote deterministically checked against the student's own answer
_parameters.EXPR: PHASE 4 (P4-10) — written-expression rubric (organisation/completeness/mechanics) on short-answer items. diagnosticOnly under dysgraphia: a more severe form of the condition mechanically depresses this regardless of how much the student learned

default.rationale: Balanced. Used when no disability is declared.

adhd.rationale: Raw accuracy is less meaningful than accuracy after attention-lapse errors are discounted. Attention span and effort weighted heavily to reward persistence rather than punish distractibility.

dyslexia.rationale: Comprehension matters far more than raw accuracy, which is depressed by decoding errors rather than misunderstanding. Reading fluency captures the speed/comprehension trade-off.

autism.rationale: Autistic students often excel at consistency and pattern recognition. These strengths should be surfaced rather than hidden behind open-ended question failures. Response-time variability (PACE_STAB) is diagnostic-only: atypical, variable processing pace is itself a feature of autism, not a measure of unreliable performance, so scoring it would penalise the student for having the condition — the same reasoning dase_profiles.json already applies to ADHD. ATT_SPAN is not declared at all: a gaze/face-presence signal is a poor proxy for attention in an autistic student (atypical eye contact does not indicate disengagement), so the webcam focus tracker is never mounted for this profile (frontend/src/types/profile.ts) and no amount of focus data could feed this profile's score regardless.

blind.rationale: Voice interaction and navigation efficiency capture how effectively content is reached. Time efficiency is de-emphasized because screen-reader navigation is inherently slower. ATT_SPAN is deliberately absent — webcam attention tracking is meaningless here.

low_vision.rationale: As blind, but time efficiency retains a little more weight since some visual access remains.

deaf.rationale: Visual engagement is the key channel; comprehension is weighted because reading is the primary input and reading proficiency is often below grade level for reasons unrelated to subject understanding. WRIT_EXP was removed rather than made diagnosticOnly (2025 weight-hygiene pass, P3-10): unlike dysgraphia, deafness does not mechanically depress written expression, so diagnosticOnly's own justification rule does not apply — it was simply dead weight with no computation source, inflating the achievable coverage ceiling for no reason. Revisit once P4-10's EXPR exists.

hard_of_hearing.rationale: As deaf, but with less weight on visual engagement since partial audio access remains.

dyscalculia.rationale: Number-concept difficulty depresses accuracy on numeric items independently of reasoning ability. Effort and learning velocity carry the signal; time efficiency is de-emphasized because number processing is slower.

dysgraphia.rationale: Written output under-represents knowledge, so KNOW (concept coverage on short-answer items) is scored directly — it only credits ideas evidenced by a verbatim quote from the student's own answer, never penalised for spelling/mechanics. EXPR (organisation/completeness/mechanics) is reported but diagnostic-only: a more severe form of dysgraphia mechanically lowers written-expression quality independent of how much the student learned, so scoring it would penalise the student for having the condition (P4-10).

anxiety.rationale: Test anxiety depresses both accuracy and speed without reflecting understanding. Learning velocity and task completion are weighted heavily because improvement over time and simply finishing are the meaningful signals. TIME_EFF is near-zero: timing pressure is the stressor.

intellectual.rationale: Progress and persistence matter more than absolute accuracy. Task completion and learning velocity dominate; raw accuracy against grade-level material is the least informative signal.

motor.rationale: Input speed is limited by physical access, not cognition, so TIME_EFF is minimized. Otherwise close to default.

_diagnosticOnlyNote: Parameters listed in a profile's `diagnosticOnly` are COMPUTED and REPORTED
(they appear on the radar chart and in the error/parameter breakdown) but are
EXCLUDED from the weighted composite score.
Rule: a parameter must not be scored in a profile if a MORE SEVERE form of that
same disability would mechanically lower it, independent of how much the student
learned. Scoring such a parameter penalises the student for having the condition.
Found by scripts/run_ablation.py: the ADHD profile originally weighted ATT_SPAN
at 0.15, which ranked a distracted-but-capable learner LAST among five archetypes
under the very profile meant to support them.
